title: Quaternionic Extensions of Hyperbolic Toral Automorphisms
summary: We construct real-analytic diffeomorphisms of \(S^3\times S^3\cong \SU(2)\times\SU(2)\) that lift We study real-analytic word maps of \(S^3\times S^3\cong \SU(2)\times\SU(2)\) obtained by evaluating Nielsen automorphisms of the free group \(F_2\). Fried studied these word maps and computed their topological entropy. For each maximal torus \(T\subset\SU(2)\), the product \(T\times T\) is invariant and carries the corresponding toral dynamics.
